description: How an artifact's source is edited and validated. `edits` pins edit_artifact's matching: old_string must occur exactly once in the current version unless replace_all is set, and a failed edit reports which way it failed as a slug rather than a message, since the wording belongs to each language. `documents` pins which sources become a version at all: the frontmatter must open the source, parse as a YAML mapping, and use only the allowed keys, so a model cannot reach Quarto options that execute code (filters, includes, engines) or change how cells run. An edit is validated the same way as a new document, so an edit that breaks the frontmatter makes no version. Accepted documents pin the frontmatter commons writes back for Quarto. Data comes from trusted calls in the code (see artifact-calls.json), not the frontmatter.

edits.name: an edit can change the frontmatter
several matches are an error without replace_all
old_string is literal text, not a pattern
an edit that changes nothing is an error
an empty old_string is an error

documents.name: the allowed keys are accepted
documents.source:
---
title: Sales
subtitle: By region
date: 2026-10-07
format: html
---

Body.

documents.name: leading blank lines before the frontmatter are ignored
a document without frontmatter is rejected
frontmatter that does not parse is rejected
frontmatter that is not a mapping is rejected
a key that can run code is rejected
execution options are commons' to set
documents.source:
---
title: Sales
execute:
  echo: false
---
Body.

documents.name: data isn't declared in the frontmatter
documents.source:
---
title: Sales
commons:
  inputs:
    orders:
      measure: order_count
---
Body.

documents.name: format options are commons' to set
documents.source:
---
title: Sales
format:
  html:
    include-in-header: x.html
---
Body.
